name: Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: Not published by the brand or its listings
summary: Vietnamese cà phê sữa sold as a vanilla latte: concentrated Da Lat and Colombian arabica over non-dairy creamer and milk powders, aseptically filled so it keeps without preservatives. Not actually on sale in the US yet — every one of King Coffee's four ready-to-drink cans reads sold out on their own store, and this one's page is still filed under "coming soon". The 8.04 oz can and $19.99 six-pack are what they publish; no nutrition panel is.
